attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Media Release" having unaudited standalone and consolidated financial details as on September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited filed a press release regarding the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR 9,403 Mn for Q2 FY27, an 87% year-on-year increase. Gross margin stood at 12.7%, while EBITDA reached INR 524 Mn, up 99% year-on-year. Profit after tax was INR 280 Mn, reflecting a 160% year-on-year growth. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue was INR 17,293 Mn, with EBITDA at INR 973 Mn and PAT at INR 517 Mn. The company added 38 stores, bringing the total network to 574 stores across five states. A conference call to discuss these results is scheduled for November 16, 2026, at 10:00 AM IST.

attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results and Limited Review Report for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 8,971.40 million for the quarter and 16,666.34 million for the half year. Standalone profit before tax stood at 357.38 million for the quarter and 673.87 million for the half year. Standalone profit for the period was 275.55 million for the quarter and 514.28 million for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 4.14 for the quarter and 7.76 for the half year. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 11,625.55 million. Total equity was 6,093.40 million. The company's registered office is in Kolhapur. The website is www.ssmobile.com.

attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is set for November 16, 2026, at 10.00 A.M. Participants include Chairman and Managing Director Siddharth Shah and Whole Time Director and Chief Financial Officer Sagar Patil. The presentation will be uploaded to the company website at WWW.SSMOBILE.COM prior to the call. The schedule is subject to change due to business exigencies. Any updates will be posted on the company website. The announcement was filed by Company Secretary Kishor Hupare.
